transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. We need to get moving on the quarter-end property reconciliation for the items currently tagged as unserviceable — battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables. Per policy, I need current technical status and disposition recommendations from each responsible section before I can sign the disposition order. Who's ready to walk me through the status on these items?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, regarding the six unserviceable battery packs — the battery shop confirmed this morning that all six have swollen casings covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin. They must be quarantined rather than repaired. Property-office pickup is scheduled for Wednesday at 1000. I should note the inspection sheet is still in our shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, IT support has completed certified data erasure on all eight rugged tablets and found them serviceable for the training cell. They need to be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer scheduled for Friday at 0900. The erasure certificates are filed in the IT ticket system, but I should note they have not been attached to the reconciliation packet yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, the power systems bench verified this morning that all four unserviceable power converters have replaceable fan modules and should be sent for repair, with repair-bench priority 2. The bench verification is complete, but I should note the work-order recommendation has not yet been posted to the maintenance control log.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Ma'am, regarding the ten electronic test cables — the calibration desk confirmed they failed their scheduled calibration check but remain suitable for controlled calibration return. They must be sent to the calibration desk with a calibration request dated Tuesday. The signed calibration worksheet is currently awaiting property-section filing.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Record battery pack quarantine disposition, six items with swollen casings per manufacturer safety bulletin, property-office pickup Wednesday 1000.
Record rugged tablet reissue disposition, eight items serviceable after certified data erasure, asset transfer to training cell Friday 0900.
Record power converter repair disposition, four items with replaceable fan modules, repair-bench priority 2.
Record electronic test cable calibration return disposition, ten items failed calibration but suitable for controlled calibration return, calibration request dated Tuesday.
Ensure battery pack inspection sheet from shop binder is entered into the maintenance control log.
Attach IT erasure certificates to the reconciliation packet before order is signed.
Post power converter work-order recommendation to the maintenance control log.
Confirm signed calibration worksheet is filed with property section.
